Nedocromil Sodium for Preventing Exercise-Induced Bronchoconstriction

Source: R/data.R
dataset01.Rd

This dataset contains summary statistics from 17 studies comparing nedocromil sodium with placebo for the prevention of exercise-induced bronchoconstriction. The outcome of interest is the maximum percentage fall in forced expiratory volume in one second (FEV1) following exercise. For each study, the sample size, mean maximum percentage fall in FEV1, and standard deviation are reported separately for the experimental (nedocromil sodium) and control (placebo) groups.

Usage

dataset01

Format

dataset01

A data frame with 17 rows and 8 columns:

author

First author of the study

year

Year of publication of the study

Ne

Number of participants in the experimental (nedocromil sodium) group

Me

Mean maximum percentage fall in FEV1 in the experimental (nedocromil sodium) group

Se

Standard deviation of the maximum percentage fall in FEV1 in the experimental (nedocromil sodium) group

Nc

Number of participants in the control (placebo) group

Mc

Mean maximum percentage fall in FEV1 in the control (placebo) group

Sc

Standard deviation of the maximum percentage fall in FEV1 in the control (placebo) group

Source

Schwarzer, G., Carpenter, J. R., & Rücker, G. (2015). Meta-Analysis with R. Springer.

Dataset downloaded from the Institute of Medical Biometry and Statistics, University Medical Center Freiburg: https://www.uniklinik-freiburg.de/imbi-en/studies-and-teaching/meta-analysis-with-r/datasets.html

Direct data file: https://www.uniklinik-freiburg.de/fileadmin/mediapool/08_institute/biometrie-statistik/Dateien/Englisch/Studies_and_Teaching/Educational_Books/Meta-Analysis_with_R/Datasets/dataset01.csv

Details

The dataset is used in Chapter 1 of "Meta-Analysis with R" to illustrate the preparation, import, and analysis of continuous outcome data in meta-analysis. The treatment effect can be expressed as a mean difference between the nedocromil sodium and placebo groups.

References

Spooner, C. H., Saunders, L. D., & Rowe, B. H. (2002). Nedocromil sodium for preventing exercise-induced bronchoconstriction. Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, (1), CD001183. https://doi.org/10.1002/14651858.CD001183
